description: This PHP source file defines the ViewModule class for the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, responsible for handling module view rendering, including loading package information, translating module types, and rendering templates with Smarty, as well as managing AJAX interactions.

classes.name: ViewModule
classes.description: Defines the ViewModule class extending SugarView for rendering module views in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder, managing module packages and templates.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the ModuleBuilder view, setting up Smarty templates, loading package data, and rendering the module interface.

methods.name: loadPackageHelp
methods.description: Sets help context for the loaded package, categorizing it as 'create' or 'modify'.
